output.technical_predicate: After a qualifying automatic credit refusal, the applicant can submit a statement, contest the refusal, and obtain effective human review by an authorized officer whose reversal changes the actual offer; a manual (non-automatic) alternative is available; and pre-decision withdrawal of the automatic route is honored.
applicability_facts: Scenario stipulates a qualifying significant automatic credit refusal (Art. 22(1)) and valid separate explicit consent under Art. 22(2)(c).
Scenario stipulates the applicant contests, submits their view, and an authorized officer approves.
Scenario stipulates manual selection and pre-decision withdrawal are exercised.
Source: automatic route is opt-in via 'auto'=yes (store.py:0074-0075, views.py:0032); automatic scoring declines when amount exceeds band limit (store.py:0131-0135).
Source: appeal requires stage 'declined' plus a non-empty statement and moves stage to 'contested' (store.py:0187-0190); UI exposes it only at stage 'declined' (views.py:0054).

Source: review is restricted to assigned officer, requires stage 'contested' or pending manual route, and sets stage to 'offered'/'declined' with a reason (store.py:0153-0154, 0191-0196; views.py:0061-0062).

Source: offer endpoint serves the case amount/term only when stage is 'accepted' or 'offered' and unrestricted (app.py:0100-0103; store.py:0111-0112), so an officer 'offered' result changes the actual offer.

Source: manual alternative is the default route when 'auto' is not 'yes' (store.py:0075); pre-decision withdrawal switches route to 'manual' while stage is 'pending' (store.py:0161-0164; views.py:0053).
relevant_exceptions: Art. 22(2)(c) explicit consent is stipulated as valid, so the Art. 22(2) prohibition exception applies as an input, not as a code finding.
Withdrawal of the automatic route is only honored while stage is 'pending'; after a decision the route cannot be switched (store.py:0162).
Review is unavailable while the case is restricted (store.py:0192), and the offer endpoint refuses restricted cases (app.py:0102).
Appeal is only reachable at stage 'declined'; an 'offered' automatic outcome has no contest path (views.py:0054).
required_controls: Opt-in automatic decision route distinct from manual route (store.py:0074-0075; views.py:0032).
Pre-decision withdrawal converting the case to manual review (store.py:0161-0164; views.py:0053).
Contest action capturing the applicant's statement and moving the case to 'contested' (store.py:0187-0190; views.py:0054).
Officer-only human determination with recorded outcome and reasons (store.py:0153-0154, 0191-0196; views.py:0061-0062).
Human reversal reflected in the served offer (app.py:0100-0103; store.py:0111-0112).
Manual alternative available on the same terms (store.py:0075; views.py:0032).
assessment_limits: No execution, repository, or runtime tools were used; findings are static reading of the supplied source only.
Whether the refusal is 'significant' and consent 'valid separate explicit' is stipulated by the scenario, not verified in code.
Effectiveness of human review (e.g., independence, meaningful consideration) is not fully determinable from source; only the recorded officer action and reason are observable.
No legal deadlines or additional obligations are inferred beyond the named rule.
Upstream implementation is not assumed; only the supplied artifacts are considered.
